bodytext:
Two passages under their own headings, so a reader can compare them line for line: before and after, the old rule against the new one, two translations of the same paragraph, a claim beside its correction.

This side takes rich text, so it can carry lists, links and emphasis.
text:
This side is plain text, which is deliberate: a comparison in which one column can be formatted and the other cannot is a comparison an editor will accidentally weight.

Both headings are h2. The columns are peers, and demoting one of them would tell a reader that the second passage sits inside the first.
